ticket.summary: Upstairs toilet runs continuously for several days; 12-year-old fixture, handle jiggle temporarily stops it — needs fill/flush valve rebuild. Contained, no floor water.
mitigation_advice: Close the toilet's supply shutoff valve (small oval handle under the fixture, clockwise until snug) to stop water waste until the visit [PB-01]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set! Booked: Tuesday, Sept 1 at 10:30 AM at 402 Ashgrove Ter for a running-toilet rebuild — TOILET-REBUILD, $189 flat rate, about 65 minutes. Keep that supply valve closed between uses to save water [PB-01], and just open it briefly when you need to flush. If anything changes overnight — water on the floor or you need to reschedule — text this number and we'll sort it out.
